metrics.label: CUDA logical-function coverage
metrics.basis: covered applicable logical entries / applicable logical entries (aliases collapsed)

metrics.label: CUDA exported-symbol coverage
metrics.basis: covered applicable symbols / applicable symbols (aliases counted separately)

metrics.label: CUDA type and constant coverage
metrics.basis: covered applicable logical entries / applicable logical entries (aliases collapsed)

metrics.label: HIP general logical-function coverage
metrics.basis: covered applicable logical entries / applicable logical entries (aliases collapsed)

metrics.label: HIP Windows logical-function coverage
metrics.basis: covered applicable logical entries / applicable logical entries (aliases collapsed)

metrics.label: HIP type and constant coverage
metrics.basis: covered applicable type/constant entries / applicable type/constant entries, platform inventories separate

metrics.label: cudarc raw-surface coverage
metrics.basis: covered applicable logical entries / applicable logical entries (aliases collapsed)

metrics.label: rocmrc raw-surface coverage
metrics.basis: covered applicable logical entries / applicable logical entries (aliases collapsed)

metrics.label: Common exact coverage
metrics.basis: unique common manifest IDs classified exact / all common exact-or-adapter IDs

metrics.label: Common adapter coverage
metrics.basis: unique common manifest IDs classified adapter / all common exact-or-adapter IDs

metrics.label: Raw-only coverage
metrics.basis: unique raw-only manifest IDs / all unique exact, adapter, or raw-only IDs

metrics.label: Runtime-resolvable coverage
metrics.basis: representable applicable function and callable-alias entries recorded runtime-resolvable / representable applicable callable entries

metrics.label: Hardware-smoke coverage
metrics.basis: applicable function entries exercised by the bounded hardware profile / applicable function entries

metrics.label: Hardware-runner execution evidence
metrics.basis: source-committed successful runner attestations / four defined opt-in backend/platform jobs; generation does not claim local hardware execution

metrics.label: Layout-verified coverage
metrics.basis: ABI-relevant record entries with exact generated per-target layout evidence and committed Rust/C assertions / ABI-relevant record entries (pointer-only incomplete tags excluded)
